title: Job Application and CV / Baabuurta Shaqaalaha iyo CV
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, aan ku hadalno 'waxaay jirta 25 sano' ama 'waxaan ka bishaaray Siyasaad', laakiin af-Ingiriisi ah ay horumariyey: aan isticmaalno fiilka 'to have' iyo xaalad u foor in 'in' ama 'from'. Ogow tan iyo tan isticmaalka 'experience' (maahee 'experiences' si aad u xilli ah) iyo goostida isku darka ee isku darka, waxa uu af-Ingiriisi ah ayuu u baahan yahay. Ka tira mana faahfaahin inaad u turjumo 'me dedico a' si 'I dedicate myself to', maxaa yeelay, waa u foor buuxda; af-Ingiriisi ah ayuu u isticmaalnaa 'I work as' ama 'I am responsible for'.
rule: Inaad ka hadashid baabuurta shaqaalaha af-Ingiriisi ah ee darajad B1: 1) Isticmaal madaxadda hantida si aad u sheegtid shaqadaada hadda: 'I work as a...' (Waxaan shaqayaa sidii...), 'I am responsible for...' (Waxaan masuul kaahayaan...). 2) In aad u sheegtid tijaabada hore, isticmaal 'used to' ama dhashay hore: 'I used to work at...' / 'I worked at...'. 3) Fiilka 'have' ayuu u isticmaalnaa inuu u sheego jirka iyo hayulkaa qalad: 'I have five years of experience' (Waxaan hayo shan sano oo tijaabo). 4) Isku darka ayay ku noqon doonaan isku darka: 'I have strong communication skills' (maahee 'skills strong'). 5) Isticmaal 'in' qaybooyinka ('experience in hospitality'), 'at' shirkadaha ('at a hotel'), iyo 'as' u adeegsanayo ('as a manager'). 6) CV-ka, ayuu u isticmaalnaa xaaladooyin fiilka dhashay hore ama hantida, maaha jawaabo kuuma.

concept_examples.text: I have five years of experience in customer service.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan hayo shan sano oo tijaabo adeegga macmiilka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv faɪv jɪrz əv ɪkˈspɪriəns ɪn ˈkʌstəmər ˈsɜrvɪs/

concept_examples.text: I am responsible for managing the sales team.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan masuul kaahayaan qalabka iibka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ æm rɪˈspɑnsəbəl fər ˈmænɪdʒɪŋ ðə seɪlz tim/

concept_examples.text: She studied marketing at the university.
concept_examples.translation: Ayay bishaarsan marketing jaamacada.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi ˈstʌdid ˈmɑrkətɪŋ æt ðə ˌjunəˈvɜrsəti/

concept_examples.text: I would like to apply for the position of cashier.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan u baaburo magaalada ee ka mid ah qalabka lacag bixinta.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə əˈplaɪ fər ðə pəˈzɪʃən əv ˈkæʃɪr/

common_error.wrong: I have 30 years and I am graduated in marketing.
common_error.correct: I am 30 years old and I graduated in marketing.
common_error.correct_alt: I am 30 years old and I have a degree in marketing.
common_error.explanation: Af-Soomaaliga, aan ku hadalno 'waxaay jirta 30 sano' iyo 'waxaan ka bishaaray', laakiin af-Ingiriisi ah ayuu u isticmaalnaa fiilka 'to be' inuu u sheego jirka ('I am 30 years old') iyo ma isticmaalino 'am graduated' maxaa yeelay, 'graduate' waa fiil oo lagu isticmaalayo codka nolosha ('I graduated'). In aad u sheegtid shaxiyada, ayuu u isticmaalnaa 'have a degree in' (hayisto shaxiyad). Khalad aan la doonayo waa inaad furdo 'old' dambe jirka. Xusuuso: 'I am + tiro + years old' iyo 'graduate from' ama 'have a degree in'.

examples.original: I am 28 years old.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈtweɪti eɪt jɪrz oʊld/
examples.translation: Waxaay jirtay 28 sano.
examples.note: Aanu u isticmaalno 'am' inaan u sheego jirka, maahee 'have' sida af-Soomaaliga.

examples.original: I was born in Mexico City.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wəz bɔrn ɪn ˈmɛksɪkoʊ ˈsɪti/
examples.translation: Waxaan la dhashay Mexico City.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'be born' dhashay hore, maahee 'born' kala duwan. 'In' magaalooyinka.

examples.original: I live in Valencia, Spain.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ lɪv ɪn vəˈlɛnsiə, speɪn/
examples.translation: Waxaan nool nahay Valencia, Isbaaniyada.
examples.note: Aanu u isticmaalno 'in' magaalooyinka iyo dalalka.

examples.original: I have a degree in business administration.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə dɪˈgri ɪn ˈbɪznəs ədˌmɪnɪˈstreɪʃən/
examples.translation: Waxaan hayo shaxiyad u adeegsanayo iibka iyo bilaabka.
examples.note: 'Have a degree in' + qaybta bishaarka. Ha isticmaal 'I am a graduate in'.

examples.original: I am proficient in English and Spanish.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ æm prəˈfɪʃənt ɪn ˈɪŋglɪʃ ənd ˈspænɪʃ/
examples.translation: Waxaan hayo darajo sare oo Ingiriisi iyo Isbaanish.
examples.note: 'Proficient in' wuxuu u sheegaa adag. Ha odhan 'I am good in'.

examples.original: I studied computer science for four years.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstʌdid kəmˈpjutər ˈsaɪəns fər fɔr jɪrz/
examples.translation: Waxaan bishaarsan computer science afar sano.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'study' + qaybta bishaarka, iyo 'for' inaad u sheegtid wakhti.

examples.original: I worked as a sales assistant for two years.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɜrkt æz ə seɪlz əˈsɪstənt fər tu jɪrz/
examples.translation: Waxaan shaqaystay sida kaalmaystaha iibka laba sano.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'work as' + u adeegsanayo, iyo 'for' + wakhti.

examples.original: Currently, I am working at a hotel.
examples.phonetic: /ˈkɜrəntli, aɪ æm ˈwɜrkɪŋ æt ə hoʊˈtɛl/
examples.translation: Haddii maanta, waxaan shaqayaa hotel.
examples.note: Isticmaal madaxadda hantida inaad u sheegtid shuqulyo waqtiga/hadana.

examples.original: I am responsible for answering emails and managing bookings.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ æm rɪˈspɑnsəbəl fər ˈænsərɪŋ ˈimeɪlz ənd ˈmænɪdʒɪŋ ˈbʊkɪŋz/
examples.translation: Waxaan masuul kaahayaan inaan u jawaabo iimaylka iyo inaan u qaado hay'adaha.
examples.note: 'Responsible for' + gerund (-ing). Ha odhan 'responsible of'.

examples.original: I used to work in customer service.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ juːst tə wɜrk ɪn ˈkʌstəmər ˈsɜrvɪs/
examples.translation: Waxaan u adeegaystay adeegga macmiilka.
examples.note: 'Used to' wuxuu u sheegaa shuqulka oo kale dhashay hore.

title: Discussing current events / Haddantus iyo tixraacyo aan u dambeysay
bridge: Faransiis, waxaan ku tiro sanaanta casriyadda aad u jira (present simple) ama casriyadda dhexdhexaad (pretérito) si aanu u sheego tixraacyada, iyo erayada 'según' ama 'dicen que'. Ingiriishi, waxaa la isticmaalaa casriyadda aad u jira (present perfect) tixraacyada dhowrsan (e.g., 'has happened') iyo casriyadda dhexdhexaad (past simple) faahfaahin xusuusan. Casriyadda jira (e.g., 'is happening') waxaa lagu isticmaalaa in badan Ingiriishi si loo sheego shuqullada jira.
rule: Si aad u hadashid tixraacyada Ingiriishi degmada B1: 1. Isticmaali casriyadda aad u jira (have/has + participio) si aad u sheegto tixraacyada dhowrsan aan loo soo bandhigin wakhti xusuusan: 'Scientists have discovered a new planet.' 2. Isticmaali casriyadda dhexdhexaad si aad u sheegto faahfaahin wakhti xusuusan: 'They announced the result yesterday.' 3. Isticmaali casriyadda jira si aad u sheegto shuqullada jira: 'The government is debating the new law.' 4. Si aad u sheegto arraadaad, isticmaali erayada 'I think', 'In my opinion', 'I believe' oo klaas la raacayo. 5. Erayada muhiimka ah: 'headline', 'article', 'report', 'according to', 'latest', 'issue'.

concept_examples.text: The government has announced new measures to reduce pollution.
concept_examples.translation: Dowladda waxay u adeegsaday sharciyo cusub si ay u qaladato eachalada.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə ˈɡʌvənmənt hæz əˈnaʊnst nuː ˈmɛʒərz tə rɪˈdjuːs pəˈluːʃən.

concept_examples.text: According to the news, the situation is improving slowly.
concept_examples.translation: Tixraacyada ayaa sheegaya in xaaladda waxay u dhexeeya in ay si joogto ah u fiicniidoo.
concept_examples.phonetic: əˈkɔːrdɪŋ tə ðə nuːz, ðə ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən ɪz ɪmˈpruːvɪŋ ˈsloʊli.

concept_examples.text: I think the article was very biased.
concept_examples.translation: Waan u maleynayaa in wararka ahaayd u dhaqsiiqsiiyay.
concept_examples.phonetic: aɪ θɪŋk ði ˈɑːrtɪkl wəz ˈveri ˈbaɪəst.

concept_examples.text: Have you heard about the election results?
concept_examples.translation: Ma aad maqashay xaaladda doorashada?
concept_examples.phonetic: hæv juː hɜːrd əˈbaʊt ði ɪˈlɛkʃən rɪˈzʌlts?

common_error.wrong: The government has announced new measures yesterday.
common_error.correct: The government announced new measures yesterday.
common_error.correct_alt: The government has announced new measures. (sin tiempo específico)
common_error.explanation: Khalaadku wuu u dhacaa maxaa yeelay Faransiis, qayb ka mid ah degmooyinka waxay ku odhan karaan 'ha anunciado ayer', laakiin Ingiriishi, casriyadda aad u jira ma lagu isticmaali karo wakhti xusuusan 'yesterday'. Isticmaali casriyadda dhexdhexaad shuqullada wakhti xusuusan. 'Yesterday', 'last week', iyo kuwa ka mid ah, ka jaga casriyadda 'have/has'.

examples.original: The economy is growing again.
examples.phonetic: ðə iˈkɒnəmi ɪz ˈɡroʊɪŋ əˈɡɛn.
examples.translation: Iqtisadiyadu wuu ku soo jeeda inuu mar kale u kordho.
examples.note: Isticmaali casriyadda jira si aad u sheegto jiritaanka aan u dambeysay.

examples.original: Scientists have found a new vaccine.
examples.phonetic: ˈsaɪəntɪsts hæv faʊnd ə nuː vækˈsiːn.
examples.translation: Ereyada waxay helay dawa cusub.
examples.note: Casriyadda aad u jira waxaa lagu isticmaalaa si loo sheego wax aan u dambeysay aan loo soo bandhigin taaryo xusuusan.

examples.original: Conflict in the region has escalated.
examples.phonetic: ˈkɒnflɪkt ɪn ðə ˈriːdʒən hæz ˈɛskəleɪtɪd.
examples.translation: Xaaladda qaybtaas waxay u badhtay.
examples.note: Fiiri isticmaalka 'has' la yiraahdo isku.

examples.original: The accident happened at 8 p.m. last night.
examples.phonetic: ði ˈæksɪdənt ˈhæpənd æt eɪt piː ɛm læst naɪt.
examples.translation: Dhibaatooyinku wuxuu u dhacay saacad 8 fiid.
examples.note: Casriyadda dhexdhexaad waxaa lagu isticmaalaa shuqullada wakhti xusuusan.

examples.original: Meanwhile, the prime minister was talking to reporters.
examples.phonetic: ˈmiːnwaɪl, ðə praɪm ˈmɪnɪstər wəz ˈtɔːkɪŋ tə rɪˈpɔːrtərz.
examples.translation: Waagaas oo dhan, waaxda sare waxay la hadlayay warjarrada.
examples.note: Casriyadda dhexdhexaad jira waxaa lagu sheegaa shuqulka jira wakhti dhexdhexaad.

examples.original: In my opinion, the government should react quickly.
examples.phonetic: ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən, ðə ˈɡʌvərmənt ʃʊd riˈækt ˈkwɪkli.
examples.translation: Arraada waa in dowladda si degdeg ah ay u timaado.
examples.note: Isticmaali 'should' si aad u sheegto tashil.

examples.original: I can't believe they decided that!
examples.phonetic: aɪ kænt bɪˈliːv ðeɪ dɪˈsaɪdɪd ðæt!
examples.translation: Anigu ma aan rumaynin inay go'aansheen ayay u go'aansadeen!
examples.note: Sheekaynta iftiinka la isticmaali 'can't believe' + casriyadda dhexdhexaad.

translations.so: Haddantus iyo tixraacyo aan u dambeysay

title: Cultural Differences and Misunderstandings / Farqiyada dhaqanka iyo su’aasha
bridge: Faransiiska, waxaan ku hadalno qalad weyn ama cabbirka si toos ah, ingiriiska waxay u adeegsan yihiin luqad aan xadgudub leh iyo adag, sida 'Waxaan u maleynayaa...' ama 'Loo baahnay...'. Ingiriiska, su’aashaduna waxay u dhaqaaqaaqaaqaansaa yihiin su’aasha cad cad u soo galaya ('Ma waxaad u malaynaysaa...?'), halkan faransiiska waxay u dhexeeyaalaan ama ku noqonaysaa. In lagu diido culaynta, waxa ugu muhiimsan in la ogaado in la codsado su’aasha sida 'Maxaad u malaynaysaa?' marka laga reebo inaad ogaansid. Waxaana la mid ah in lagu isticmaalo wakhtiga fiilka: Ingiriiska waxay isticmaalaan fiilka dambe ee dhammaan, halkan faransiiska waxay u adeegsan yihiin fiilka dambe ee dhammaan ee dhowrsan yihiin.
rule: In lagu hadlo farqiyada dhaqanka iyo su’aasha ingiriiska, waxa ugu muhiimsan in la qabto: 1) Su’aalo aan xadgudub leh: 'Ma ayaxad u sheegtaa?' marka la yidhaahdo 'Sheegtaa'. 2) Hadaladii fiican: 'Waxaan u maleynayaa', 'Waxaan u maleynayaa', 'Waxaan u maleynayaa' si aanad u noqon inaad u adag tahay. 3) Su’aalo cad cad u soo galaya: 'Ma waxaad u malaynaysaa...?', 'Ma waxaad leedahay...?' si aad u cad cad u soo galaysid wixii qofkale u yidhi. 4) Isticmaal fiilka dambe ee dhammaan ee dhammaan: 'Waxaan ku fiicnay' (maahee 'Waxaan ku fiicnay' haddii ayan jirin xiriir leh ee dhexeeya). Ka baxa tarjmacii oo xadgudub ah 'in lahaa xaq' (to be right, ma aha 'to have reason') iyo 'in lahaa baahida' (to need, ma aha 'to make lack').

concept_examples.text: I thought you were coming at 7, but you came at 8.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan u maleynayay inaad soo noqon lahaa 7, laakiin waxaad soo noqotay 8.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɔːt juː wɜːr ˈkʌmɪŋ æt ˈsɛvn bʌt juː keɪm æt eɪt/

concept_examples.text: Could you repeat that? I didn't understand.
concept_examples.translation: Ma ayaxad ku celinaysaa? Ma fahmayn.
concept_examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː rɪˈpiːt ðæt aɪ ˈdɪdnt ˌʌndərˈstænd/

concept_examples.text: In my culture, it's polite to take off your shoes.
concept_examples.translation: Dhaqanadaada, waa adag inaad furtaa cagahaaga.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ ˈkʌltʃər ɪts pəˈlaɪt tə teɪk ɒf jɔːr ʃuːz/

concept_examples.text: He said he'd call, but he didn't.
concept_examples.translation: Wuxuu yidhi inuu soo dhowaa, laakiin ma uu yeelin.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː sɛd hiːd kɔːl bʌt hiː ˈdɪdnt/

common_error.wrong: You have reason, but I think different.
common_error.correct: You're right, but I think differently.
common_error.correct_alt: You may be right, but I see it differently.
common_error.explanation: Khalaadku wuu u dhacaa maxaa yeelay faransiiska waxay leedahay 'in lahaa xaq' (literally 'to have reason') iyo 'in lahaa fikrad kale' (aan adverbi leh). Ingiriiska waxay isticmaalaan 'to be right' (maahee 'to have reason') iyo adverbi 'differently' (maahee adjective 'different'). Inaad ka baxdo, xusuuso in 'reason' waa magac isagoo leh 'sababo', ma aha 'xaq' ee u dhexeeya inaad xaq u ahayd.

examples.original: I think that's a good idea.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ðæts ə gʊd aɪˈdɪə/
examples.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa inay wanaagsan tahay.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'I think' marka la yidhaahdo 'I believe' si aad u adag tahay hadalka.

examples.original: Maybe we could try another way.
examples.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi wiː kʊd traɪ əˈnʌðər weɪ/
examples.translation: Loo baahnay inaan jarrabno si kale.
examples.note: 'Maybe' waa adag, la mid ah 'qudha' faransiiska.

examples.original: I'm not sure that's true.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm nɒt ʃʊə ðæts truː/
examples.translation: Anigu ma qiniisanayn inay run tahay.
examples.note: Ingiriiska waxay isticmaalaan 'not sure' si ay u hadlaan shaki aan u adag leh.

examples.original: What do you mean by that?
examples.phonetic: /wɒt duː juː miːn baɪ ðæt/
examples.translation: Maxaad u malaynaysaa?
examples.note: Su’aalkan waa toos ah laakiin aan xadgudub leh; waa fiican in la isticmaalo 'What?' oo darii ah inay u noqon karo adag.

examples.original: Could you explain that more slowly?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː ɪkˈspleɪn ðæt mɔːr ˈsloʊli/
examples.translation: Ma ayaxad u sheegtaa si adag?
examples.note: 'Could' waa adag 'can' marka la codsado taageerada.

examples.original: Do you mean the meeting is tomorrow?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː miːn ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ ɪz təˈmɒroʊ/
examples.translation: Ma waxaad u malaynaysaa in shirka ay tahay berri?
examples.note: Isticmaal 'Do you mean...?' si aad u cad cad u soo galaysid fahintii aad lahayd.

examples.original: In Spain, people eat lunch late.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn speɪn ˈpiːpl iːt lʌntʃ leɪt/
examples.translation: Isbaaniyada, dadku way nasaansan yihiin.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'in + dal' marka la hadlaa dhaqanka.

examples.original: That's very different from my culture.
examples.phonetic: /ðæts ˈvɛri ˈdɪfərənt frɒm maɪ ˈkʌltʃər/
examples.translation: Waxaa u kala duwan dhaqanadaada.
examples.note: 'Different from' waa saxanka ingiriiska, ma aha 'different of'.

examples.original: We never do that in my country.
examples.phonetic: /wiː ˈnɛvər duː ðæt ɪn maɪ ˈkʌntri/
examples.translation: Dalkayguna ma naga sameyn.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'never' horka fiilka guud.

examples.original: It was a misunderstanding.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz ə ˌmɪsʌndərˈstændɪŋ/
examples.translation: Waxay ahaayd su’aal.
examples.note: Magaca mishaarka waa la isticmaalo su’aasha.

title: Discussing Environmental Topics / Waxbarasho daraadka maha
bridge: Farooda, inoo dhexeeyo camal ku dhacdo waqti dabeecad ah, waxaynu isticmaalannaa mudaraku dabeecad ah ('waxaynu cadaadisanaynaa') ama mudaraku dhex socda ah ('waxaynu cadaadisanaynaa' oo kala duwan). Ingiriisi, kala duwanaanshuhu wuxuu u muhiim: mudaraku dabeecad ah ('waxaynu cadaadisanaynaa') camal ama xaqiiq ah oo umuma eyna, inta uu mudaraku dhex socda ah ('waxaynu cadaadisanaynaa') camal ku dhacdo waqti dabeecad ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Ingiriisi, inoo dhexeeyo camal ku dhacdo mustaqbal ku qabsan (sida 'Waxaynu ku daraynaynaa cadaadisku'), waxay isticmaalaan 'be going to' ama mudaraku dhex socda ah, inta uu Farooda waxaynu isticmaalannaa mustaqbal ('waxaynu ku daraynaynaa'). Fiirsoona inaad isticmaashid 'should' inoo dhexeeyo tashil, Farooda waxaynu isticmaalannaa 'deberíamos'.
rule: Inoo dhexeeyo daraaddo maha Ingiriisi mudaraku B1, waxaad u baahan tahay inaad u qasabtaa: 1) Mudaraku dabeecad ah (xaqiiq ah umuma: 'Dunyaha waxay ku dhacaya inay ku noqoto qalalan' – halkan waxay isticmaalay mudaraku dhex socda ah sababtoo ah ay noqoto qalalan; xaqiiq ah: 'Qarashada dhibaato waxay ku dhacaya inay ku noqoto qof kasta'), 2) Mudaraku dhex socda ah (camal ku dhacdo: 'Beeraha waxay ku dhacaya inay ku noqoto'), 3) 'be going to' + fiil (qorshe mustaqbal: 'Waxaynu ku daraynaynaa inaynu soo bandhigenno panada shariica'), iyo 4) 'should' + fiil (tashil: 'Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad ku darayso cadaadiska'). Xusuuso in Ingiriisi, mudaraku dabeecad ah waxay ku dhacaya inay ku noqoto '-s' dadka saddexaad oo ah (isag/iyada/iyaga). 'there is/are' (hay), xusuuso in 'there is' waxaynoqoto ujeedada, 'there are' waxaynoqoto ujeedada. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, isticmaal conectors sida 'sababo', 'sidaa darteed', 'sidaa darteed' inoo dhexeeyo idea-yo. Ha u bixin inay adjektives ku noqoto noun Ingiriisi ('energy shakhsiya', 'energy shakhsiya').

concept_examples.text: We are reducing our carbon footprint by using public transport.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaynu ku daraynaynaa inaynu ku darayso cadaadiska carbona ee ay noqoto macmiilka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ɑːr rɪˈdjuːsɪŋ ˈaʊər ˈkɑːrbən ˈfʊtprɪnt baɪ ˈjuːzɪŋ ˈpʌblɪk ˈtrænspɔːrt/

concept_examples.text: Climate change affects everyone, but we can still make a difference.
concept_examples.translation: Qarashada dhibaato waxay ku dhacaya inay ku noqoto qof kasta, laakiin waxaynu ku daraynaynaa inaynu ku darayso kala duwanaanta.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈklaɪmət tʃeɪndʒ əˈfɛkts ˈɛvriwʌn, bʌt wiː kæn stɪl meɪk ə ˈdɪfərəns/

concept_examples.text: If we don't act now, the planet will suffer serious consequences.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii aanu maantino, dunyaha waxay ku dhacaya inay ku noqoto dhibaato cadaadiska.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː doʊnt ækt naʊ, ðə ˈplænɪt wɪl ˈsʌfər ˈsɪriəs ˈkɒnsɪkwənsɪz/

concept_examples.text: You should replace plastic bags with reusable ones.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad bedeldo qalabka plastic qalabka isticmaalka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd rɪˈpleɪs ˈplæstɪk bæɡz wɪð riːˈjuːzəbəl wʌnz/

common_error.wrong: We are recycle the plastic bottles in our house.
common_error.correct: We recycle the plastic bottles in our house.
common_error.correct_alt: We are recycling the plastic bottles in our house.
common_error.explanation: Khalaadahu wuxuu u dhexeeyaa kala duwanaanta mudaraku dabeecad ah iyo mudaraku dhex socda ah. Farooda, 'reciclamos' waxaynoqoto camal ama camal ku dhacdo. Ingiriisi, haddii ay noqoto camal ama camal, isticmaal mudaraku dabeecad ah ('recycle'); haddii ay noqoto camal ku dhacdo, isticmaal mudaraku dhex socda ah ('are recycling'). Ma isticmaali karo 'are recycle' – fiilka u dhexeeya wuxuu u baahan yahay inuu ku noqoto '-ing' mudaraku dhex socda ah.

examples.original: Air pollution is a serious problem in many cities.
examples.phonetic: /ɛər pəˈluːʃən ɪz ə ˈsɪriəs ˈprɒbləm ɪn ˈmɛni ˈsɪtiz/
examples.translation: Cadaadiska hawada waxaynoqoto dhibaato weyn magaalo badan.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'is' xaqiiq ah umuma. Xusuuso in 'pollution' ma aha qiyaastii, sidaa darteed ma isticmaali karo 'a pollution'.

examples.original: The oceans are getting warmer because of climate change.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈoʊʃənz ɑːr ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈwɔːrmər bɪˈkɒz əv ˈklaɪmət tʃeɪndʒ/
examples.translation: Baddiyada waxay ku dhacaya inay ku noqoto qalalan sababo qarashada dhibaato.
examples.note: Isticmaal mudaraku dhex socda ah 'are getting' inoo dhexeeyo qalalan ku dhacdo.

examples.original: There is too much plastic waste in the environment.
examples.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz tuː mʌtʃ ˈplæstɪk weɪst ɪn ðə ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt/
examples.translation: Waxaa jira cadaadis plastic badan maha.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'there is' nouns sida 'waste'. Ha adda 'there are waste'.

examples.original: Deforestation destroys the habitat of many animals.
examples.phonetic: /ˌdiːfɒrɪˈsteɪʃən dɪˈstrɔɪz ðə ˈhæbɪtæt əv ˈmɛni ˈænɪməlz/
examples.translation: Qoro-qorashadu wuxuu cadaadisaa meel baxa haybad badan.
examples.note: Mudaraku dabeecad ah xaqiiq ah umuma. Xusuuso '-s' dadka saddexaad: 'destroys'.

examples.original: We are planting more trees in our neighborhood.
examples.phonetic: /wiː ɑːr ˈplæntɪŋ mɔːr triːz ɪn ˈaʊər ˈneɪbərhʊd/
examples.translation: Waxaynu ku daraynaynaa inaynu soo bandhigenno beeraha jirka.
examples.note: Mudaraku dhex socda ah camal ku dhacdo. 'Plant' waxay noqotay 'planting'.

examples.original: Our school is going to start a recycling program.
examples.phonetic: /ˈaʊər skuːl ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə stɑːrt ə riːˈsaɪklɪŋ ˈproʊɡræm/
examples.translation: Xoolaha waxay ku daraynaynaa inay bilaabmayso shir cadaadiska.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'be going to' qorshe mustaqbal. Qalabka 'is going to' waxay ku dhacaya inay ku noqoto hadalka xaqiiqa ah.

examples.original: We should use less electricity to save energy.
examples.phonetic: /wiː ʃʊd juːz lɛs ɪlɛkˈtrɪsɪti tə seɪv ˈɛnərdʒi/
examples.translation: Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad isticmaashid qalabka shakhsiya inaad badbaadid qalabka.
examples.note: 'Should' fiilka u dhexeeya (maa 'to'). 'Less' qiyaastii; 'fewer' qiyaastii.

examples.original: If everyone recycles, we will reduce pollution.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ˈɛvriwʌn riːˈsaɪkəlz, wiː wɪl rɪˈdjuːs pəˈluːʃən/
examples.translation: Haddii qof kasta cadaadisaa, waxaynu ku daraynaynaa inaynu ku darayso cadaadiska.
examples.note: Shartiga ugu horeeyey: 'if' + mudaraku dabeecad ah, 'will' + fiil. 'Everyone' waxaynoqoto ujeedada.

examples.original: I think that electric cars are a good investment for the future.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ðæt ɪˈlɛktrɪk kɑːrz ɑːr ə ɡʊd ɪnˈvɛstmənt fɔːr ðə ˈfjuːtʃər/
examples.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa in qalabka shariica ah ay noqoto shakhsiya mustaqbal.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'I think that' arrimaha. Marka laga reebo 'think', conjunction 'that' waxaynoqoto optional.

examples.original: In my opinion, recycling should be mandatory in every city.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən, riːˈsaɪklɪŋ ʃʊd biː ˈmændətəri ɪn ˈɛvri ˈsɪti/
examples.translation: Arkayga, cadaadiska wuxuu u baahan yahay inuu noqoto shaxsiyadda magaalo kasta.
examples.note: Tusaale 'in my opinion' + 'should be'. 'Recycling' waxaynoqoto noun, sidaa darteed fiilka u dhexeeya waxaynoqoto ujeedada.

examples.original: The government should invest more in renewable energy sources.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt ʃʊd ɪnˈvɛst mɔːr ɪn rɪˈnjuːəbəl ˈɛnərdʒi ˈsɔːrsɪz/
examples.translation: Dowladda wuxuu u baahan yahay inay soo bandhigento qalabka shakhsiya.
examples.note: Tashil 'should'. Adjektive 'shakhsiya' wuxuu u dhexeeya noun.

examples.original: If we don't stop deforestation, many species will become extinct.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː doʊnt stɒp ˌdiːfɒrɪˈsteɪʃən, ˈmɛni ˈspiːʃiːz wɪl bɪˈkʌm ɪkˈstɪŋkt/
examples.translation: Haddii aanu maantino qoro-qorashadu, haybad badan waxay ku dhacaya inay ku noqoto.
examples.note: Shartiga 1 'if we don't'. 'Species' waxaynoqoto ujeedada iyo ujeedada.

title: Talking About Technology and Social Media / Hadal ka bixinta tigeerada iyo bulshada shabakada
bridge: Faransiiska, ayaan amaanta u adeegnaynaa mudada hadalka ee ku saabsan xiiso iyo shuqulka (misaal 'haddii aad hadda u eegto telefonooyinka'), laakiin Ingiriishi, kuwanu wuxuu u dhexeeyaa mudada hadalka iyo shuqulka ee ku dhex jira. Sidaa darteed, hadalka ka bixinta tigeerada, kuwaan kasoo hadalaya faransiiska ayay ku guuleystaan qoraalka 'I have to click' ama 'I like the photo' oo aan la isticmaalo 'me'. Fiirso phrasal verbs (sidoo kale 'log in', 'sign up') oo aan lahayn mid ka mid ah faransiiska oo ay ku guuleystaan qoraalka oo ah qoraal.
rule: Si aad u hadashid tigeerada iyo bulshada shabakada Ingiriishi ee darajada B1, isticmaal: 1) Mudada hadalka ee xiiso iyo xaalado (I check my phone every morning). 2) Mudada shuqulka ee ku dhex jira (I am scrolling through Instagram right now). 3) Qoraalka ee ku saabsan soo jeestada iyo awooda: can, should, must (You should update your password). 4) Phrasal verbs ee ku saabsan: log in, log out, sign up, turn on, turn off, set up. 5) Qoraalka ee ku saabsan 'like' iyo 'share' (I like the post, She shared the video). Xusuuso in Ingiriishi aan la isticmaalin harufka ee hore 'social media' (I spend time on social media, aan 'in the social media'). Hadana, si aad u soo bixiso malkii ee ku saabsan qalabka, isticmaal 'have' (I have a new phone) oo aan 'tengo' ahayn.

concept_examples.text: I usually check my social media in the morning.
concept_examples.translation: Cadad u mahad sanaysaa bulshada shabakada aan ku hayo subaxdii.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli tʃek maɪ ˈsoʊʃl ˈmiːdiə ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: She is posting a story on Instagram right now.
concept_examples.translation: Ayay ku shubtaysaa sheek oo cusub Instagram hadda.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ˈpoʊstɪŋ ə ˈstɔːri ɑːn ˈɪnstəɡræm raɪt naʊ/

concept_examples.text: You should log out of your account on public computers.
concept_examples.translation: Waa inaad furtaa sesinkaaga oo ku salaysaa computer-ka dadka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd lɔːɡ aʊt əv jʊər əˈkaʊnt ɑːn ˈpʌblɪk kəmˈpjuːtərz/

concept_examples.text: Can you help me set up my new laptop?
concept_examples.translation: Ma ayaad i caawisaa inaad u qorshato laptop-ka cusubta?
concept_examples.phonetic: /kæn juː hɛlp miː sɛt ʌp maɪ nuː ˈlæptɑːp/

common_error.wrong: I am agree with you about social media.
common_error.correct: I agree with you about social media.
common_error.correct_alt: I agree on that point about social media.
common_error.explanation: Faransiiska waxay nuugtaa 'estoy de acuerdo', laakiin Ingiriishi 'agree' wuxuu u ah qoraal ee aan la isticmaalin mudada shuqulka. Si aad u ergo tashiifkan, xusuuso in 'agree' aan lahayn 'be' hore. Tashiif kale ee ku saabsan wuxuu yahay 'I am agree', laakiin saxanka wuxuu yahay 'I agree'. Hadana waxaad u isticmaali kartaa 'I agree with you' (waxaan ku fiicnay) ama 'I agree on that' (waxaan ku fiicnay).

levels.label: Basic Vocabulary and Phrases for Tech
levels.translation: Qoraalka asasiga iyo jumbalada ee ku saabsan tigeerada

examples.original: I need to charge my phone.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tə tʃɑːrdʒ maɪ foʊn/
examples.translation: Waa inaan soo shubto telefonooyinkayga.
examples.note: Qoraalka 'charge' wuxuu u bixiyaa soo shubtada (battery). Faransiiska waxay nuugtaa 'cargar' si ay u soo shubto telefonooyinka, laakiin Ingiriishi aan lahayn 'load' ee ku saabsan.

examples.original: My laptop is very slow.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlæptɑːp ɪz ˈvɛri sloʊ/
examples.translation: Laptop-kaygu waa mid aad u dhareg.
examples.note: Fiirso in Ingiriishi 'slow' wuxuu u bixiyaa xawaaraha computer-ka, sidaa darteed faransiiska, laakiin aan lahayn 'late' (tarde).

examples.original: Do you have a charger?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː hæv ə ˈtʃɑːrdʒər/
examples.translation: Ma ayad u hayso charger?
examples.note: Su'aasha ee ku saabsan hadalka. Xusuuso in 'charger' wuxuu u ah charger-ka, aan 'loader' ahayn.

levels.label: Describing Online Activities
levels.translation: Sharciyeya shuqulka ee ku saabsan shabakada

examples.original: I'm scrolling through my feed.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈskroʊlɪŋ θruː maɪ fiːd/
examples.translation: Waxaan ku dhex marayo feed-kayga.
examples.note: Phrasal verb 'scroll through' wuxuu u bixiyaa dhexmarinta shashada. Faransiiska waxay nuugtaa 'deslizar' ama 'hacer scroll', laakiin Ingiriishi waxay nuugtaa 'scroll' sida qoraal.

examples.original: She uploaded a new video yesterday.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi ʌpˈloʊdɪd ə nuː ˈvɪdioʊ ˈjɛstərdeɪ/
examples.translation: Ayay soo shubtay video cusub maalintii baxay.
examples.note: Ingiriishi 'upload' wuxuu u bixiyaa soo shubtada content-ka; faransiiska waxay nuugtaa 'subir' laakiin hadana 'montar' ee ku saabsan dialect-ka. Halkan waxay nuugtaa mudada shuqulka ee hore.

examples.original: He liked my post and commented.
examples.phonetic: /hiː laɪkt maɪ poʊst ænd ˈkɑːmɛntɪd/
examples.translation: Wuxuu jeclaa sheek-kayga iyo waxuu qoray.
examples.note: Fiirso in Ingiriishi waxay nuugtaa 'he liked' (aan 'he liked it' ahayn haddii ay la ogaado) iyo qoraalka 'like' aan lahayn pronome indirecto sida faransiiska 'le gustó'.

examples.original: Are you following that influencer?
examples.phonetic: /ɑːr juː ˈfɑːloʊɪŋ ðæt ˈɪnfluənsər/
examples.translation: Ma ayad raacayaa influencer-ka?
examples.note: Qoraalka 'follow' wuxuu u bixiyaa shabakada shabakada. Faransiiska waxay nuugtaa 'seguir' sidaa darteed, laakiin Ingiriishi waxay nuugtaa sidaa darteed. Fiirso isticmaalka mudada shuqulka ee ku saabsan su'aasha.

levels.label: Discussing Pros and Cons of Social Media
levels.translation: Nidaamiska xumaha iyo xumaha ee ku saabsan bulshada shabakada

examples.original: Social media can be addictive.
examples.phonetic: /ˈsoʊʃl ˈmiːdiə kæn biː əˈdɪktɪv/
examples.translation: Bulshada shabakada ayay noqon kartaa adkaad.
examples.note: Waxay nuugtaa modal 'can' si ay u soo bixiso suurtagal. Faransiiska waxay nuugtaa 'pueden ser', laakiin Ingiriishi qoraalka modal aan lahayn mid ka mid ah shakhsi.

examples.original: One advantage is that you can connect with people worldwide.
examples.phonetic: /wʌn ədˈvæntɪdʒ ɪz ðæt juː kæn kəˈnɛkt wɪð ˈpiːpəl ˈwɜːrldwaɪd/
examples.translation: Faa'iido yahay inaad u xidhiidhiso dad oo ku salaysaa dunida oo dhan.
examples.note: Halkan waxay nuugtaa 'one advantage' si ay u soo bixiso xaalad. Faransiiska waxay nuugtaa 'una ventaja es que', laakiin Ingiriishi qoraalka waxay nuugtaa sidaa darteed.

examples.original: However, it can waste a lot of time.
examples.phonetic: /haʊˈɛvər, ɪt kæn weɪst ə lɑːt əv taɪm/
examples.translation: Halse yahay inay ku darboodo wakhti badan.
examples.note: Ereegta 'however' wuxuu u ah mid oo rasmi ah. Faransiiska waxay nuugtaa 'sin embargo'. Fiirso in 'waste' wuxuu u bixiyaa darbooda, aan lahayn 'spend' (wakhti).

examples.original: I think it's better to limit screen time.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ɪts ˈbɛtər tə ˈlɪmɪt skriːn taɪm/
examples.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa inay ku habboon tahay inay xad gudba waktiga shashada.
examples.note: Waxay nuugtaa 'it's better to' + infinitive si ay u soo bixiso tashriimo. Faransiiska waxay nuugtaa 'es mejor que limites', laakiin Ingiriishi waxay nuugtaa 'to limit'.
